sloka: ततः सम्भाषिता चैव सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता ।रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता ।। ५.५९.३३ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sambhāṣitā caiva sarvamarthaṁ ca darśitā ।rāmasugrīvasakhyaṁ ca śrutvā prītimupāgatā ।। 5.59.33 ।।।।

translations.english: "I created a little confidence in the fawneyed lady by pacifying her and explaining her with great difficulty the alliance of Rama and Sugriva on hearing which she became happy.
